mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate environment consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, the central bank is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with unemployment rate below 4.0%, a rising employment growth rate (PAYEMS) signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% in 1 month, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate consistently signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer and housing demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in 1 month, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
